**Using the Compact Espresso Machine (KT-5006) in London:** No, not safely. It's built for 120 V, 60 Hz North American power only. The UK runs on 220–240 V, so a simple plug adapter only changes the plug shape, not the voltage — it will damage the machine. Using it with a voltage converter or transformer also **voids the warranty**. If you're moving to a 220–240 V country, it's best to buy an espresso machine locally there.

**Shipping to your new UK address:** We don't ship internationally. Tom's Kitchen ships only to all 50 US states, Washington DC, Puerto Rico, and APO/FPO/DPO military addresses — not the UK or any other country.

Note: cookware, knives and storage items work fine anywhere and can ship to any US address before your move, if that helps.
